chunks: And to God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and on the Day the Hour will be established, on that Day the falsifiers will be the losers.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the falsifiers on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Az-Zumar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transition from divine sovereignty to ultimate accountability, where 'Al-Mubtilun' (those who nullify truth) face total ruin, reinforcing the concept of Haqq vs. Batil. It serves as a pivotal reminder for believers to align their actions with divine will, ensuring they are not among those whose deeds are rendered void on the Day of Resurrection. The verse connects God's eternal power with the temporal reality of judgment, urging spiritual vigilance.
